choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: Why, I lived almost on the same floor with the poor old man. Ah, yes, about a year after the disappearance of his son the poor old man died.
Why, the doctors called his complaint gastro-enteritis, I believe; his acquaintances say he died of grief; but I, who saw him in his dying moments, I say he died of——
Captain Gaumard, recovered from his illness, had returned from Palma.

title: Morrel — a toast to Sinbad the Sailor
